chunks: Muḥammad ibn Yaʿqūb, from a number of our companions, from Aḥmad ibn Muḥammad, from al-Ḥusayn ibn Saʿīd, from Faḍālah, from Muʿāwiyah ibn ʿAmmār, who said:
Whoever dies and does not have a sacrificial offering for his tamattuʿ, then his guardian should fast on his behalf.

key_terms.هَدْيٌ: the sacrificial offering required in the context of hajj al-tamattuʿ

ai.seo_question: If someone dies without having the hady required for hajj al-tamattuʿ, should the wali fast on his behalf?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling regarding one who dies before fulfilling the required sacrificial offering of tamattuʿ in hajj. It indicates that the wali assumes responsibility to fast on behalf of the deceased in place of that unmet obligation.
